summary: Add the inactive fractal-jobs request, lifecycle and per-field coverage contract; no runtime path uses it.

schema.detail: Pure Rust types only; no stored schema changes.

rules.detail: No admission policy or numeric fleet limits. IO weight is advisory, not an IO limit. Duration estimates and optional hard clocks are distinct.

compatibility.detail: No existing consumer depends on this crate. Cancellation requires durable cancel-requested state and confirmed whole-tree stop; host loss remains unknown until recovery. Tagged max-hold, holder-lost and outcome-unwritten infrastructure failures are distinct from process exit codes.

recovery.detail: Removing the unused crate leaves runtime behavior unchanged.
